project.title: Neighbourhood Safety Intelligence Network (NSIN)
project.short_description: A neighbourhood emergency and safety platform (React web, native Android, FastAPI) with IBM Db2 as the system of record: transactional SOS and incident lifecycle with an append-only audit trail, semantic protocol retrieval and duplicate-report detection with native Db2 VECTOR columns and VECTOR_DISTANCE, and response-time and hotspot analytics computed in Db2 SQL. Runs on a least-privilege Db2 role.
project.category: Civic Safety / Hybrid RAG / Analytics / Full-Stack (Web + Android)

members.name: Yagnik Sharma
members.role: Full stack: backend, IBM Db2 integration, triage pipeline, web and Android

ibm_db2.edition: Db2 12.1 Community Edition (Docker, icr.io/db2_community/db2); compatible with Db2 on IBM Cloud over SSL
features_used: VECTOR(384, FLOAT32) columns with VECTOR_DISTANCE (COSINE) for semantic retrieval and related-incident search
Analytics in SQL: CTEs, SECONDS_BETWEEN, MEDIAN, PERCENTILE_CONT WITHIN GROUP, RANK() OVER, HOUR()
14 tables with primary, foreign and unique keys, identity columns and 11 secondary indexes
ACID transactions (SOS writes incident, location, history and audit atomically)
Least-privilege role NSIN_APP (data access only, append-only audit table) with CURRENTSCHEMA
SYSCAT catalog queries for schema checks; db2look DDL export
Prepared, parameterised statements via ibm_db.prepare / execute; SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 health probe

ai_models: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings (local ONNX via fastembed, stored in Db2 VECTOR columns)
No hosted LLM: deterministic triage agents with Haystack BM25 + Db2 vector hybrid retrieval
